payloads.description: Probe for CORS/ header reflection by sending attacker-controlled Origin header and observing response headers for Access-Control-Allow-Origin or other header changes.
Inject Origin with a unique attacker-controlled domain to detect header reflection or out-of-band fetch.

prerequisites.description: Include Referer header observed in original requests for realistic client-like requests
prerequisites.custom_logic: Set Referer: https://brokencrystals.com/ on each request

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains Access-Control-Allow-Origin header equal to sent Origin or other headers echoing the Origin value
External DNS/HTTP callback observed to attacker-controlled Origin domain

test_cases.notes: Observe response headers and external callbacks for CORS misconfiguration or header reflection. Use Referer header to mimic observed traffic.

payloads.description: Probe for header reflection or behavior changes when Referer is attacker-controlled.
Referer with unique callback URL to detect out-of-band interactions or reflected headers.

prerequisites.description: Include Origin header matching observed sample to simulate realistic client requests
prerequisites.custom_logic: Set Origin: https://brokencrystals.com on baseline probes; use attacker Origin only for Origin-focused test TC-H002-01

oracle_rules.condition: Response contains headers echoing Referer or CORS-related headers set to attacker Referer value
External DNS/HTTP callback observed to attacker-controlled Referer domain

test_cases.notes: Check response headers and monitor OOB for indications of inclusion or header-driven fetches. Prefer running after TC-H002-01 probe baseline.

payloads.description: Baseline request to /api/config?id=1 to establish response size and status code.
Second probe to compare response length and status code differences against baseline.
Probe with a non-numeric id to check for status code changes or differing response sizes.

prerequisites.description: No authentication observed; if auth required, provide valid context
prerequisites.custom_logic: If 401/403 observed, abort and set needs_observation for auth_flow in runtime feedback

oracle_rules.condition: Response body length for different id values differs by >30% compared to baseline indicating id-based data exposure
Different id values produce status codes in [200,404,403] indicating existence or access control differences
External DNS/HTTP callback observed when requesting /api/config?id=<value>

test_cases.notes: Compare multiple id values to detect sensitive data exposure or existence enumeration. Record response sizes and status codes. Stop and escalate if auth required.

payloads.description: Request known pb parameter value (from observation) to validate baseline and observe external interactions.
Modify pb slightly to detect if requests trigger external fetches or cause different behavior.

oracle_rules.condition: Observing network activity to google domains or related external resources when requesting embed URL with modified pb parameter

test_cases.notes: Use observed pb value and slight variations to validate external embedding behavior. Low priority; run after local-domain probes.
